name: gw
description: The Graph Works plugin: a path-native work-item pipeline plus a wiki scan/ingest/query/lint surface, driven through the gw CLI, alongside brainstorming, planning, TDD, debugging and delivery workflows for coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: A work-item pipeline and knowledge wiki for coding agents, plus planning, TDD, debugging and delivery workflows
interface.longDescription: Use Graph Works to drive work items stage by stage — brainstorming, implementation planning, test-driven development, systematic debugging, parallel execution, code review, and finish-the-branch — against a persistent wiki you scan, ingest into, query and lint, all through the gw CLI.
